title: Prune Legacy Log Entry
description: In a distributed logging system, records are maintained as a singly linked list of events. You are tasked with removing the n-th log entry counting from the end of the chain, and then returning the head of the modified log list.
constraints: The number of nodes in the list is sz.
input_format: The head of a singly linked list and an integer n.
output_format: The head of the modified singly linked list.

examples.explanation: The 2nd node from the end is 4, which is removed.
Removing the only node leaves an empty list.
